english_title: Uniform Convergence Version of Dirichlet Convergence
statement_en: Assume that: 1. the partial sums $\sum_{n=1}^{N} b_n(z)$ are uniformly bounded for every positive integer $N$; 2. for every $z \in D$, the sequence $a_n(z)$ decreases monotonically to $0$. Then the series $\sum_n a_n(z)b_n(z)$ converges uniformly on $D$.
callout_body:
1.  $\sum_{n =1}^{N}b_n(z)$对任意正整数$N$一致有界
2.  $a_n(z)\forall z \in D$单调收敛到0

如果满足上述条件，那么$\sum_{n} a_n(z)b_n(z)$在$D$上一致收敛。
